# Deltempo

> Deltempo is a free, portable, open-source **disk cleaner**, RAM/memory optimizer, deep app uninstaller, and duplicate file finder for Windows 10 and 11. Zero telemetry, 100% local, MIT licensed, no installer required.

- [Official Website](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/): Primary homepage, interactive simulator, and downloads
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Beso1227/Deltempo): Source code, issues, and community contributions
- [Download](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/download/): Standalone executable and one-line PowerShell install
- [Documentation](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/docs/): Technical guide to 26+ scopes, safety tiers, and CLI commands
- [FAQ](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/faq/): Common questions on safety, GPU caches, NT memory, duplicate finder, and app uninstallation
- [Comparison](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/compare/): Head-to-head table vs CCleaner, BleachBit, and Bulk Crap Uninstaller
- [Alternatives](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/alternatives/): Best free CCleaner alternatives for Windows 11 and 10, with what each does best
- [Changelog](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/changelog/): Release notes and version history
- [Full AI Context](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/llms-full.txt): Complete machine-readable capabilities, CLI reference, comparisons, and FAQs
- [Machine Catalog](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/ai-catalog.json): Structured product metadata

## Overview
Deltempo safely purges disposable system, developer, and browser caches, recovers gigabytes of disk space, thoroughly uninstalls desktop programs with leftover cleanup, detects byte-level duplicate files, provides an interactive storage treemap, provides startup intelligence, and trims inactive Windows memory working sets with zero telemetry.

One-line install: `irm https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/win | iex`

## Core Capabilities
- **26+ Cleaning Scopes**: System temp, DirectX/GPU shader caches, browser caches, dev artifacts (NuGet, npm, pip, Cargo, Gradle), and crash dumps.
- **Byte-Level Duplicate File Finder**: 3-stage high-performance detection pipeline (exact size grouping, 4KB header prefix comparison, and SHA-256 cryptographic verification) with strict Windows system folder immunity.
- **Squarified Treemap Storage Visualizer**: Interactive nested graphical map utilizing the squarified treemap layout algorithm (Bruls, Huizing, van Wijk) for zero-dependency disk space drilldown.
- **Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) & Restore Point Manager**: Enumerate restore points, generate checkpoints before operations, and safely prune obsolete snapshots based on retention limits.
- **Scheduled Maintenance Automation & Explorer Context Menu**: Windows Task Scheduler integration for automated unattended cleanups and right-click folder cleaning directly in Windows File Explorer.
- **Low Disk Shield & Tray Guardian**: Proactive background tray telemetry alerts when free disk space falls below safety thresholds.
- **Deep Root App Uninstaller**: Powered by BCU engine; performs silent bulk removals, multi-drive root residual sweeps, registry and AppData leftover cleanup, and force-removals of corrupt/broken software.
- **Optional System Restore Points**: Pre-uninstall restore point creation is an optional toggle, turned off by default to conserve disk and avoid freezes.
- **Application & Startup Intelligence**: Answers "Will anything go wrong if I disable or uninstall this?" with 3-tier verdicts (SafeToDisable, CautionNeeded, EssentialKeep), offline heuristics, and multi-provider AI support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio).
- **Process Manager with Native Icons**: Real-time process inspection with live high-DPI icon extraction from running executables.
- **Chris Titus Tech WinUtil (CTT) 1-Click Launcher**: Runs the third-party WinUtil utility in an elevated PowerShell window. WinUtil is by Chris Titus (https://christitus.com/win), is not MIT licensed, is not part of Deltempo, and is not covered by Deltempo's safety audit or release verification.
- **Native NT Memory Optimizer**: Standby list flushes and working set trims via `NtSetSystemInformation` and `EmptyWorkingSet`.
- **Multilingual RTL Architecture (partial)**: Language selector for English, Arabic, Spanish, French, and German. The Cleaner workspace is translated and Arabic activates native RTL flow; modals and the other workspaces remain English.
- **Pro Eye-Comfort Themes**: Obsidian Titanium (Dark) and Porcelain Slate (Light) engineered for reduced eye strain and zero glare.
- **AppData Footprint Report (read-only)**: Largest-first breakdown of what occupies `%LOCALAPPDATA%` and `%APPDATA%`, in the app and via `deltempo appdata-report`. There is no delete code path on either surface. Orphaned Microsoft Store apps are identified from binary AppModel repository evidence, matched on publisher ID, and reported as `LowRisk` and unselected.
- **Deliberate Refusals**: Deltempo never offers load-bearing paths as cleanup targets, even when they look exactly like scratch: MSI source caches (`%ProgramData%\Package Cache`, `%WinDir%\Installer\$PatchCache$`), the per-user .NET SDK install root, bare driver vendor roots (`C:\NVIDIA`, `C:\AMD`, `C:\Intel`, `C:\Realtek`), `~\.cargo\registry\src`, and Audacity unsaved-session recovery. AppData *durable state* (OneDrive sync databases, Office/Outlook credentials, Credential Manager vaults, recent-file jump lists, SSH and GnuPG keys, the `NTUSER.DAT`/`UsrClass.dat` shell hives) is refused per-directory, so a recursive purge cannot remove it as collateral.
- **Zero Telemetry & 1480 Automated Tests**: All operations run 100% locally; completely free and open-source under the MIT license with 1480 automated tests enforcing 0 regressions.
